kultivator.kota_besar.kota.inspired: Inspired by Tang-dynasty Chang'an: a gridded city with an East Market and a West Market, drum towers that mark the curfew and gates shut at night; by the Jia Ma Royal City and the Central Plains city (Zhongzhou) with its Pill Tower in Battle Through the Heavens; and by Zhang Zeduan's painting 'Along the River During the Qingming Festival' for the bustle of its streets. The layout, prices and numbers are game design.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.inspired: Inspired by the axial plan of Beijing's Forbidden City (halls on the central line, layered gates) and the pavilions of sect elders in cultivation novels; game design.
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.source: Source: the Lantern Festival (Yuanxiao) on the first full-moon night of the lunar new year, with riddles hung on the lanterns (cai dengmi). Holding it every full moon is game design.

East Arch of the South Gate

kultivator.sibuk.tempat.pertahanan: Defending a capital gate against a beast tide.

kultivator.kota_besar.jam_malam.pagi: The morning bell: the capital gates open again.

kultivator.kota_besar.gerbang.tolak_musu: The gate is not opened for an Enemy of the City.

kultivator.kota_besar.gerbang.dibuka: The guard takes %s NB and opens the gate for a moment.

A guard captain has been sent to hunt you.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.awas: Don't try anything in this city. I'm watching you.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.berhenti: Halt! Pay your fine or come along to the Yamen.

kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.lunas: Fine of %s paid. Your record is cleared.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.masuk_sel: You gave yourself up. Sentence: %s seconds in the cell; your belongings are not taken.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.sel_kata: Sit still and think about what you did.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.sel_terkunci: The cell door is locked tight.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.bebas: Sentence served. The cell door opens and your record is cleared.
kultivator.kota_besar.hukum.kabur: You escaped from the cell! +%s crime points.

kultivator.kota_besar.yamen.bersih: There is no crime on record in your name.
kultivator.kota_besar.yamen.lunas: Paid. The magistrate strikes your name from the list.
kultivator.kota_besar.yamen.jarak_jauh: Your record from afar. Fines are paid at the Yamen or to a guard who stops you.
kultivator.kota_besar.papan.buronan.koso: No one is wanted. The city is at peace.
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.seru: A beast tide! Everyone to the walls!
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.pertanda: War drums over %s. Beasts are coming for the %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.roboh.su: Beasts pour into the Gate District. Hold them back!
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.menang.s: The people of %s cheer behind the walls.
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.kalah.su: The shops of %s close for a day to recover.
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.hadiah: Nama Baik +%s (now %s); the city purse gives you %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.gelombang.hadiah_u: Foremost defender! Nama Baik +%s (now %s); the city purse gives you %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.belum_buka: This event is not open yet.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.gelombang_bi: A beast tide comes every twenty days or so, or the night after a Blood Eclipse. Take to the walls with the guards.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.lelang_agung: The Grand Auction is held in the Grand Auction Hall of the East Market. Hand your consignments to the auctioneer before the day.
Every evening the twelve stalls of the Night Market open with wares that change.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.ringkasan.fe: The last Lantern Festival was a joy: a sky full of lanterns and fireworks.
The last Lantern Festival went by without visitors from outside.
The Lantern Festival was called off for the Blood Eclipse.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.ringkasan.pi: The last Pill Gathering has its champion.
Only guild alchemists took part in the last Pill Gathering.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.ringkasan.tu: The last Grand Tournament has crowned its champion.
kultivator.kota_besar.acara.ringkasan.pe: The last beast tide was driven back from the walls.
The last beast tide broke through a gate; the city is still mending.
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.sub: A full moon over %s. The lanterns are lit!
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.catatan: Answer the riddles of the Riddle Keepers on the Great Square. A right answer gives a Lantern Charm and Nama Baik +1 (at most %s times).
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.habis: You've answered every riddle tonight. Come back next full moon.
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.benar: Correct! You get a Lantern Charm and Nama Baik +1.
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.benar_tan: Correct! One more Lantern Charm for you.
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.tawa.3: That riddle made three scholars weep last year!
kultivator.kota_besar.festival.tawa.5: My lantern is still lit. You still have a chance!
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.mulai: The Pill Gathering begins at the Alchemist Guild!
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.catatan: Entry %s. After entering you have %s minutes to finish one pill in a furnace of the Guild District.
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.terdaftar: Entered! Light your furnace: %s minutes start now.
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.terlambat: Your time is up; this pill is not judged.
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.juara.sub: Your pill scored %s points and took first place.
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.hasil: Pill Gathering: you placed %s of %s (%s points).
kultivator.kota_besar.pil.tanpa_pil: You entered but finished no pill.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.sub: Enter with the Grand Arena stewards before the first round at %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.buka: Heroes of the realm, prove your strength upon this stage!
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.catatan: Entry %s. First round at %s; 90-second duels, stopped at 10 %%, no stakes.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.terdaftar: Entered as your sect's representative. Be at the lei tai at %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.tutup_daf: Entries are closed: the first round has begun.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.tonton: Spectator seats are on the stands of all four sides. Sect-against-sect bouts are shown on the stage.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.walkover: %s was not ready on the lei tai: a walkover.
kultivator.kota_besar.turnamen.waktu_hab: The duel ran out of time.
kultivator.kota_besar.piala.lore: Awarded to %s, champion of the Grand Tournament of %s, day %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.piala.lore2: Pure gold carved with clouds and the emblems of eight sects.
kultivator.kota_besar.hari_gerbang.catat: Rent a recruiting stall for %s and invite up to %s hopefuls today (sect hall level 2 or higher).
Those who wish to join our sect, step forward!
Is your spirit root strong? Show it here!
A hundred years of tradition await you!
Three meals a day and a manual every month!
Don't be shy, the test doesn't hurt!
Our sect gate is open today only!
kultivator.kota_besar.rekrut.kunci: Your hall is not yet large enough to recruit in the capital.
kultivator.kota_besar.rekrut.kunci.syara: Needs a sect hall of level %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.rekrut.terima: %s accepts your invitation and waits at your hall.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.catatan: One proposal per council: a pact of friendship or a gift; standing with that sect +%s.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.soal: The envoy of %s (stance: %s) awaits your proposal.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.sudah: Your proposal for this council has been made.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.0: The northern trade road must be guarded together.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.1: Our sect will not bow to threats.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.2: This year's beast tides are fiercer.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.3: The border in that valley must be settled.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.4: Our disciples were hurt on the road. Who answers for it?
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.5: The next tournament must be fair to all.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.6: We propose lowering the stall tax.
kultivator.kota_besar.pertemuan.bicara.7: The Prince Warden has been wise.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.tolak_nb: Only Heroes of the City are received in the throne hall.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.sapa: The Prince Warden raises a hand. "Raise your head. I hear your name spoken in the markets and on the walls."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.sapa_tamu: "Our honoured guest returns. What news from the roads?"
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.pangeran_ka: From this day you are an honoured guest of this palace.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.gelar_sub: The Palace Minister will now give you Palace Orders.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.diterima: You are named an Honoured Guest of the Palace.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.diterima_la: The Prince nods to you warmly.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.0: "This city stands on the pact of eight sects. We guard; we do not rule."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.1: "The night drum is not to frighten our people, but the beasts beyond the walls."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.2: "The Money House is older than this palace. Even I owe them."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.3: "The founder carved his name on the monument, went into the mountains and never came back."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.4: "Don't believe every rumour of the Slums. But don't ignore them either."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.5: "Every full moon the lanterns rise for those who fell on the walls."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.6: "The Great South Gate fell once, in the beast tide of the third year. Its new leaves were forged from the swords of the guards who fell."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.7: "Sect elders may fly over the city, but in this hall everyone walks. So says the pact."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.8: "The pagoda of the Great Library keeps one blank scroll. The founder said it is for history not yet written."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.9: "My father judged an elder who stole from the Money House. The elder laughed, then paid his fine twice."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.10: "The first cloud ship was a fishing boat's sail and one wind pearl. Now the Sky Dock serves a route to every capital."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.cerita.11: "Sleep at an inn, not on the roofs. Our night watch startles easily, and their spears fly true."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.belum_tamu: Palace Orders are only for Honoured Guests of the Palace.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.syarat_tamu: First be received in audience by the Prince Warden (Nama Baik 80).
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.menteri_bar: The minister unrolls a new scroll. "Three tasks for this term, each paid %s."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.menteri_ada: The minister checks the records. "Your tasks are still open. Each pays %s."
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.catatan: Palace Orders change every %s days. Finishing all three earns a rare spirit herb.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.tugas.kawal: Escort a palace envoy to another town
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.tugas.saran: Slay the master of a beast lair
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.terbit: Palace Orders issued. The targets are in your records.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.utusan_bawa: A palace envoy will walk with you.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.utusan_suda: Your envoy is already travelling with you.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.kawal_sudah: The escort is done or there is no destination town yet.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.utusan_gaga: No envoy can leave right now.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.utusan_tiba: We have arrived. The palace thanks you.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.utusan_hila: The palace envoy is no longer with you. Ask the Minister for a new one.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.iblis_maju: Demon lair: %s of %s demonic cultivators down.
kultivator.kota_besar.istana.langka: All three orders fulfilled: the Minister sends you a rare spirit herb.
kultivator.kota_besar.teleport.kosong: You know no place to travel to yet.
kultivator.kota_besar.teleport.ditolak_b: Refused: your face is on the wanted board.
kultivator.kota_besar.teleport.ditolak_s: Refused: that sect's stance toward you is too cold.
kultivator.kota_besar.teleport.tak_ada_t: There is no safe arrival point there.
kultivator.kota_besar.teleport.kanal: The array kindles... bound for %s. Stay still.
kultivator.kota_besar.dermaga.kosong: No known destination 600 blocks or more away.
kultivator.kota_besar.dermaga.tutup: The dock is closed. Cloud boats leave from %s to %s.
kultivator.kota_besar.dermaga.naik: The cloud boat rises through the clouds toward %s...
kultivator.kota_besar.jasa.peta.catatan: Districts, services and the event calendar
kultivator.kota_besar.peta.belum: You haven't found a capital yet.
kultivator.kota_besar.peta.belum.syarat: Follow an Imperial Road or ask at a tea house.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.pencerahan: The lecturer's words open something in your heart.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.0: Qi flows like a river; don't dam it, guide it.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.1: A hasty disciple builds his tower on sand.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.2: Man's three treasures: jing, qi and shen. Keep all three.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.3: Morning breathing draws bright qi; evening breathing quiets the soul.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.4: A pill is only a crutch; your own feet must walk.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.5: Heart demons are born of desires never admitted.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.6: A cracked foundation shatters the golden core.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.7: The Dao is not far off in the mountains; it is in a cup of tea.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.8: A blade is sharpened on a whetstone, a mind on hardship.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.9: The strong do not prove their strength on the weak.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.10: The five elements nourish and subdue one another; so do people.
kultivator.kota_besar.kuliah.ajar.11: Every breakthrough begins with one honest breath.
kultivator.kota_besar.pengamat.meteor: From the top of the tower you catch two spirit meteor fragments falling by the deck.
kultivator.kota_besar.pengamat.gerhana: The eclipse light settles in the armillary: an Eclipse Crystal forms.
kultivator.kota_besar.pengamat.gerhana_k: The eclipse glowers, but the armillary catches nothing tonight.
kultivator.kota_besar.pengamat.kembar: Dew under the twin moons drips into the watcher's cup.
kultivator.kota_besar.uji.tanpa_kota: There is no capital near here.
